subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Learns to spell ten words a week from phonics lessons

show.line: Spelling time! Say the word, hear the sounds, write the letters. Ship. sh, i, p.

rounds.prompt: Fish. Which tile has the right letters?
Spell frog with sounds. Say each sound.
Which word is spelled with a mistake?
rounds.praise: You found it! That one has the wrong letters.

rounds.prompt: Listen. th, i, n. Which word is it?
Read your spelling word to me.

hints: Say the word slowly. Write one letter for each sound.
Two-letter sounds need both letters. sh, ch, th.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will spell chip.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Chip starts with ch, not sh.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's hear the start. Ch, ch, chip. c, h first!

parent_line: Can spell short words with digraphs by hearing each sound.
